name: Maki Kazuma
source: Kazuma is the current head of the Maki family, one of the three great warrior clans. Known for their passionate spirit, the Maki warriors have passed this trait down through generations, and Kazuma embodies it fully. He serves as the vice-chairman of the Hokutokai (Sworn Blades), but refuses to acknowledge acting chairman Hotori’s authority, leaving the organization divided. Despite the disparity in military strength, Kazuma boldly calls for resistance, a stance that has earned him the admiration and loyalty of many young warriors.
